answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a cipher spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a falcon header. Producing 32 answers an epoch thus costs 53 real forward passes, and the terrace record lets any auditor recompute the check. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
